# Hearth BP monitor OCR

Experimental local OCR for upright three-row home monitor displays. Bundled
ONNX detector and digit recognizer, browser worker, Python research reference.
AGPL-3.0-only; retain dependency notices. More than 90% prospective precision
has not been established. All returned values require human verification.

## Start here

- [AI integration handoff](docs/AI_INTEGRATION.md): context and implementation prompt.
- [Integration guide](docs/INTEGRATION.md): browser/PWA, Python and native Android boundaries.
- [API reference](docs/API_REFERENCE.md): worker messages, result schema, tensors and preprocessing.
- [Examples](examples/README.md): browser client and single-pass Python script.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): runtime flow and source map.
- [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): training, evaluation, release and troubleshooting.
- [Model card](docs/MODEL_CARD.md): weights, provenance and limitations.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): complete documentation map.
- [License](LICENSE): AGPL-3.0-only project license.
- [Third-party notices](prototype/THIRD_PARTY.md): dependencies and upstream attribution.
